name: Aizawa Haru
source:
In an unexpected turn of events, the protagonist of this story gets transported to Peek-a-Boy, a world where everyone has their eyes covered. With the help of a boy she met there named Shigure, she ends up enrolling as a student at his school, the Hidden Eyes Private School…?!

‘Still not sure about how things work around here, but…nice to meet you!’
‘I have to pick one no matter what…don’t I?’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
